costMethod.note: costUsd is the instrument's share of development cost, including integration and test (same meaning as costUsd in parts.json), not its price. Values are representative for an example project, set by class: CubeSat-sized TRL 9 instruments $0.6–2M, small-satellite instruments $4.5–6M, and not-yet-flown instruments about 1.5–1.75 × a flown instrument of the same class. Tuned in the playability check (APIDoc.md, TODO T7.6).

Modelled on the neutron spectrometers of Lunar Prospector and LRO (LEND): counts neutrons to find hydrogen in the top metre of soil. All values are our game values.
Modelled on the Moon Mineralogy Mapper (Chandrayaan-1): sees the infrared signature of water and hydroxyl. All values are our game values.
Modelled on the Mini-RF and Mini-SAR radars (LRO, Chandrayaan-1): radar echoes reveal ice in permanently shadowed craters. All values are our game values.
